summary: Compositing and layers work improved scrolling, overscroll behavior, input routing, and process-to-process safety across WebRender, APZ (asynchronous panning and zooming), and compositor bridges. It also strengthened video and image handling, including HDR metadata, Wayland HDR playback, RTP video orientation for WebRTC, Android hardware buffers, DMABUF, and GPU texture recycling. These changes should make scrolling and media rendering more reliable across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and Wayland, with several fixes aimed at preventing crashes, flashes, and incorrect colors.
